block_policy: The compiler owns every line between markers on listed generated surfaces. Stable prose may explain the projection outside the block but may not hand-copy registry-managed volatile values in a Current section. The homepage is an explicitly non-generated human summary and is never a Current Snapshot output.

human.purpose: short human-readable Current orientation without adding a heading

ai.purpose: cold-start and handoff recovery with explicit source paths

machine.purpose: compact key/value Current projection for machine readers

non_generated_surfaces.reason: The public homepage is maintained as a human identity summary with two direct project/value blocks and a default-collapsed component navigation; machine Current state belongs in the linked AI, current-state, architecture, changelog and snapshot records.

historical_policy: Historical sections may retain prior task/map/version values only when their section/date/metadata explicitly marks them Historical; the classifier must not treat those mentions as Current assertions.
claim_ceiling: Generated blocks prove deterministic repository-local projection consistency only; they grant no authority, external truth, production readiness, Owner acceptance or epistemic acceptance.
